name: dsh-chat-rewind
description: Conversation rewind commands for DeepSeek Harness web: /undo rolls the chat back one turn, /rewind <seq> cuts the conversation back to a chosen message (both the model context and the transcript, durably persisted). Host half truncates the live session log and rewrites the JSONL artifact; browser half resyncs the conversation window on a host-pushed session/rewind event.
